spotlights.title: Diesel is over Shs 7,000 a litre. Get a free fuel assessment for your fleet.
spotlights.body: We measure your own vehicles first, so you decide on real numbers. School fleets: book before term closes on 4 December.
spotlights.title_sw: Dizeli imepita Shs 7,000 kwa lita. Pata tathmini ya mafuta bila malipo kwa magari yako.
spotlights.body_sw: Tunapima magari yako kwanza, ili uamue kwa takwimu halisi. Magari ya shule: weka nafasi kabla ya muhula kufungwa tarehe 4 Desemba.

campaigns.name: Nov 2026 FET assessment, email 1: schools
campaigns.subject: {name}: a free fuel check for your fleet before December
campaigns.preheader: A free on-site assessment, with prices published up front.
paragraphs: Dear {name},

Term Three closes on 4 December, and most school buses will then be parked until the end of January. With diesel now above Shs 7,000 a litre in Kampala, the holiday is the easiest time to look at what your buses cost to run.

Fuel Eco Tech is a device fitted to the fuel line, with no engine modification. In an independent field test by CTI GmbH in Germany, a VW T5 used 13.9% less fuel with it fitted. Results differ by vehicle and driving, which is why we start with a free fuel assessment of your own vehicles, before you decide anything.

Our prices are published openly, with installation included: from UGX 1,891,000 for cars and mini-buses up to UGX 10,015,000 for heavy trucks. You can see all four devices and today's stock at vitorra.org/products/fuel-eco-tech/catalogue.
If you would rather talk, reply to this email or WhatsApp us on +256 740 026 294.

Kind regards,
The Vitorra team
Padre Pio House, Plot 32, Lumumba Avenue, Kampala
